headline: Crystal Lake prequel promises brutal kills
post:
Hey friends! If you love classic horror, we have some exciting updates about the upcoming prequel series "Crystal Lake". According to The Hollywood Reporter, series creator Brad Caleb Kane shared at a New York Comic Con panel that the show will feature “really creative kills” and be “a lot more brutal” than the movies.

The show explores the timeline between Jason's childhood drowning and the events of the original film. Star Linda Cardellini discussed diving into the complex psychology of Pamela Voorhees. She explained that she loved the whodunit aspect of the original and appreciated exploring a character experiencing such intense rage.

Filming even returned to the original New Jersey woods where the first movie was shot to capture that authentic summer camp feel. The team also explored Jason's background and the relationship between him and his mother before the tragedy occurred. 

Are you excited to dive deeper into the origins of this classic franchise?

#CrystalLake #FridayThe13th #HorrorNews
original_title: ‘Crystal Lake’ Will Offer More Brutal Kills Than Films, Go Deep on Jason’s Background

headline: Michael Douglas avoided David Letterman for years
post:
Michael Douglas recently shared in his new memoir, “One Helluva Ride,” that he stopped appearing on David Letterman’s late-night program after a final visit left him deeply upset. According to Page Six, the actor explained that Letterman aired an old commercial featuring his late mother without warning and began questioning him about it in a way that felt like making fun of her.

Feeling that the host “went too far,” Douglas chose to decline all future interview requests for nearly two decades, even after receiving personal notes of apology. He ultimately decided to put the feud behind him following his cancer diagnosis in 2010, noting that clearing the air felt like a relief.

Have you ever held onto a grudge for a long time? 🎬

#MichaelDouglas #DavidLetterman #PageSix
original_title: Michael Douglas reveals why he refused to appear on David Letterman’s talk show: ‘Went too far’

headline: Alfonso Cuarón looks back on Harry Potter
post:
